pages.title: X Marks the Trouble
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Buy locators from cartographers. They find targets; campaign admission, native awakening and encounter rewards remain unchanged.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: A locator leads to its registered target without bypassing ritual, gatekeeper or structure requirements. Eyes come from legitimate campaign outcomes; the book does not gift eyes or signature drops.
